Fields.Name: Variable
Fields.Description: The variable (or character property, depending on the binding type) bound to the member path.

Fields.Name: Member Path
Fields.Description: The field the binding drives, as a path from the object (e.g. selectedGeneratorIndex, or children:0/weight).

Fields.Name: Bit Index
Fields.Description: For a bool written into a flags field, the bit it sets. -1 for the whole field.

Fields.Name: Binding Type
Fields.Description: Whether the value comes from a behavior variable or a character property.
